name: The Drowned City

entrance.note: Forever-only dungeon off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, west of Grom'gol. Entrance is underwater (reported) at 21.0, 28.0. Catalog verified:false. Official location: west of Grom'gol.

fromHubs: Grom'gol: swim west of the camp and dive to the reported 21.0, 28.0 cavern.
Orgrimmar: zeppelin to Grom'gol, then swim west and dive.
Booty Bay: pick up Shady Saltseers and The Saltseer Captain from Krazek (26.95, 77.21), fly Gringer to Grom'gol, then swim west.

Mulgore / Thunder Bluff: pick up Ancient Gurubashi Idol from Mazu'kon at Skywatcher Plateau (32.5, 20.66) before leaving Kalimdor. Turn it in there after the run; do not send that turn-in to Orgrimmar.
travel.how: Fly or zeppelin to Grom'gol, swim west and dive (catalog hordeAccess; steps-v2 run text). Entrance coordinates are reported, not in-game verified.

quests.name: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
quests.notes: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City. Horde. No XP in QuestieDB v1.1.3 or web/public/data/quests.json. steps-v2 routes: balanced only. foreverConfidence:high.

quests.name: Shady Saltseers
quests.notes: Collect 10 Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates. Neutral (races 0). No XP in QuestieDB or web quests.json. steps-v2 routes: balanced only. foreverEvidence includes authoredFix.

quests.name: The Saltseer Captain
quests.notes: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise. Neutral. No XP in QuestieDB or web quests.json. steps-v2 routes: balanced only.

quests.name: The Drowned City
quests.notes: Tablet rubbings inside the dungeon. QuestieDB pre.single is Locating the Lost City (95770). README also names The Vile Reef (629) and The Gurubashi Legends of Old (95748), which chain 629 → 95748 → 95770. No steps-v2 accept/turnin. Run tip: do not take the tablet rubbings that need The Vile Reef. No XP in any local source. foreverConfidence:high. Horde.

quests.name: The Only Good Brinescale...
quests.notes: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City. QuestieDB pre.group: Locating the Lost City (95770) and Enemies in the Water (95773). README names those plus the Vile Reef chain behind 95770. No steps-v2 accept/turnin. Run tip: do not take the brinescale count that needs The Vile Reef. No XP in any local source. foreverConfidence:high. Horde.

quests.name: A Tale Spun Around the Fire
quests.notes: Follow-up of 95775. +2350 XP. Turn in to Master Gadrin, Sen'jin Village. QuestieDB NPC 3188 at 55.95, 74.72.

prep.group: 5-player Forever dungeon. Swim west of Grom'gol and dive. Catalog has no role tips. Dive once around level 40.
prep.hearth: Innkeeper Thulbek, Grom'gol 31.49, 29.75. Booty Bay Innkeeper Skindle (27.04, 77.31) if turning in Krazek. Thunder Bluff / Mulgore if turning in Mazu'kon.
warnings: Entrance 21.0, 28.0 is reported and catalog verified:false. Official text is only 'west of Grom'gol'.
Do not take 95775 tablet rubbings or 95776 brinescale/Var'Taka until The Vile Reef chain is done (steps-v2 run tip).
Quests 79953 and 81951 are not used (dungeons.json note).

At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP (Blizzard Forever hotfixes through 20 Nov 2026).
All five Horde/neutral quests stay verified:false until checked in game. Do not invent XP or extra Forever mechanics.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Drowned City sits on the Grom'gol coast in the same band as the first and second STV circuits in levels-20-40.route-v2.json. Those 4-minute Bloodscalp / Grom'gol defense / crystal completes are the overworld XP a 35-40 dive would replace.
Same level band on the 20-40 route. Shadowprey naga and Ghost Walker centaur/satyr completes are the other slow Kalimdor work a speedrun could drop if diving STV instead.

sourceConflicts: 95775 prerequisites: README lists The Vile Reef, The Gurubashi Legends of Old, and Locating the Lost City. QuestieDB pre.single is only 95770. The named quests are the chain 629 → 95748 → 95770, not three parallel pre.group requirements.
95775 and 95776 are in dungeons.json (5 of 5 Horde quests) but have no dungeons:forever:the-drowned-city:accept/turnin steps. steps-v2 run tip tells the player not to take them without The Vile Reef.
Forever dungeon XP is absent from content/questie-db (no xp field) and web/public/data/quests.json (xp null on 96774/95789/95791; 95775/95776 not in that file). XP left null.
steps-v2 accept/run/turnin for this dungeon are routes: balanced only, while the run-step tip also lists speedrun. Catalog has no route.balanced/speedrun flags on Forever quests.
Entrance 21.0, 28.0 comes from a fan guide cited in dungeons.json (hardcorehelper), marked verified:false. Official Blizzard text is only the west-of-Grom'gol location.
notes: Forever-only dungeon (id the-drowned-city). Official levels 35-40, west of Grom'gol. 5 of 5 Horde catalog quests matched to QuestieDB v1.1.3; all verified:false. Pack emits 96774, 95789, and 95791 only.
